Jujube Cake
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, February 12, 2010 - 4:01pm

Ingredients




pound Dried jujubes
2 tablespoons Ginseng powder
pound Glutinous rice flour

Preparation

1 Knead the jujube with the glutinous rice flour, add Ginseng. Make dough into any form of large biscuit, place in biscuit molds. Steam cook for 5 to 10 minutes. Cakes should be very soft but keep their shape.
